messages:
ashley: CI red on main: //runtime:serve:test — failing intermittently: TestRetryRaceCondition. Job: https://ci.internal/redwood/3421
ashley: failing assert in logs: `assert_eq!(retries, 2)` but observed 3 sometimes
ashley: stack shows timer fired twice while retry still scheduled
dan: can someone kick a rerun? looks transient
ashley: kicked a rerun for the job
ci-bot: rerun started by ashley — https://ci.internal/redwood/3421#rerun
ci-bot: rerun finished — still failed (same assertion)
jon: hmm. timing/jitter problem smells likely. Can you try `--runs_per_test=100` locally or `RUST_TEST_THREADS=1`? also try setting TEST_SEED for deterministic RNG
maria: repro locally with `bazel test //runtime/serve:test --runs_per_test=50` — fail ~1/20. snippet:
```
thread 'test_retry' panicked at 'assertion failed: retries == expected', runtime/src/retry.rs:124:9
stack: runtime::retry::backoff::start_timer -> runtime::serve::dispatch -> ...
```
maria: I can repro with `RUST_LOG=debug` — see interleaved timer callbacks at ~12ms apart
ashley: starting git bisect now
sre-bot: FYI tagging this test as flaky in flaky-test-tracker:runtime/serve (auto)
ashley: bisect points to commit abcdef1 (2026-02-18) — changes to jitter logic: switched to uniform jitter sampling instead of seeded deterministic jitter
ashley: commit diff: `jitter = rng.uniform(0..max_jitter)` (previously deterministic via test-seed)
jon: that explains nondet behavior. Unit tests relied on predictable ordering. Two paths can schedule retries concurrently and jitter change removed the implicit ordering
rachel: quick options: 1) make test use a fake clock and deterministic RNG, 2) add a test-only hook to inject a mock timer, or 3) increase min backoff in test to avoid overlap. I prefer fake clock for unit tests :+1:
ashley: I'll open a PR with a fake-clock shim and keep the production jitter as-is. Will also add a note to the retry module docs and mark the test flake gate
dan: ping me on the PR for a quick review, I can help with the fake clock impl
maria: also add `--runs_per_test=200` to the test CI job temporarily while we fix it to catch regressions
ashley: will do. opening PR now and linking back — sending PR in this thread once ready :thumbsup:
jon: also file a follow-up to consider safer defaults for jitter to reduce test fragility; not necessarily change behavior but document
ashley: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/runtime/pull/789 — includes fake clock, test update, and flaky test label
rachel: looked — left a small comment about cleaning up test-only hooks
ashley: thanks all, merging after CI green and two approvals. cc @eng-runtime for final eyes
